name: kb-queries
description: Questions over knowledge_base/ with the sections that answer them. Written before retrieval was tuned; wording deliberately differs from the policies (paraphrases, synonyms such as 'supplier' or 'bill'). 'relevant' lists document_key and the section heading that contains the answer; a retrieved chunk counts when it belongs to that section (or one of its subsections). Unanswerable questions have no relevant section: the evidence gate should refuse them.
